subject: Hold: Pre-demo vendor gating + exec travel causing schedule shift
messages:
From: Nina Patel <nina.patel@medicorelabs.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tom Reeves <tom.reeves@medicorelabs.com>, procurement@medicorelabs.com
Date: Fri, 25 Jun 2027 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Scheduling Redwood demo — vendor onboarding items

Hi Ben — thanks for the invite. Two things blocking us on our side before the live demo: (1) our security team requires the completed vendor questionnaire and a countersigned NDA in the vendor portal; (2) our CTO (Tom) will be travelling next week and asked to attend or watch synchronously. We started the questionnaire but hit a couple of technical fields (data-at-rest, KMS/HSM integration) that need clarification from your security doc.

Can you confirm where to upload the signed NDA and whether we can get a short security Q&A with your infra/security lead this week? If we can’t close those items before Tom’s travel, we’ll need to move the demo to the following week.

Attachments: MediCore_Vendor_Questionnaire.pdf (partial)

— Nina
Vendor Security, MediCore Labs

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Nina Patel <nina.patel@medicorelabs.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 25 Jun 2027 10:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Scheduling Redwood demo — vendor onboarding items

Nina — thanks for the heads up and the partial questionnaire. Totally understand the gating. Quick replies: 

• Uploads: you can attach the signed NDA in the vendor portal link Monica pasted earlier (we also attached a countersigned copy to this thread).
• Security Q&A: Karthik (cc’d) can do a 20–30 min sync to walk the questionnaire sections you flagged — available Friday 3pm PT or Monday 10am PT.
• Exec presence: if Tom will be traveling and can’t join, we can record a short segment for him but prefer live for Q&A; happy to rebook if necessary.

Would you prefer we keep the originally proposed slot (Tue 29 Jun 11am PT) tentatively and move only if the questionnaire/NDA aren’t complete by Monday? Let us know and we’ll hold the calendar.

Attachments: NDA_signed_MediCore.pdf (countersigned)

— Ben
Enterprise AE, Redwood Inference

From: Tom Reeves <tom.reeves@medicorelabs.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Nina Patel <nina.patel@medicorelabs.com>
Cc: procurement@medicorelabs.com
Date: Mon, 28 Jun 2027 08:10:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Scheduling Redwood demo — vendor onboarding items

Ben, apologies — I’ll be in transit Tue morning and won’t be able to make the 11am PT slot. I can do Wed 30 Jun 9am PT or Thu 1 Jul 2pm PT. If you’re flexible to move, that would be helpful. Also, procurement flagged two additional fields on the questionnaire (data retention SLA and audit log retention) — happy to have Monica/Karthik put a note into the doc where you can confirm.

— Tom

From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
To: Tom Reeves <tom.reeves@medicorelabs.com>, Nina Patel <nina.patel@medicorelabs.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 30 Jun 2027 09:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Scheduling Redwood demo — vendor onboarding items

Tom/Nina — thanks. We can accommodate Wed 30 Jun 9am PT. Karthik and I will be on the call to run through the questionnaire items live. To make the session efficient, please paste the two procurement questions directly into the questionnaire and flag them; Karthik will provide concrete values for data retention and audit log windows and note where we can support a custom retention profile for regulated datasets.

Pre-demo agenda attached — we’ll keep the walkthrough to 35 minutes followed by 15 minutes of security-focused Q&A. If you prefer a different cadence for Tom, let us know and we’ll rebook.

Attachments: pre-demo-agenda.docx

— Monica
Customer Solutions, Redwood Inference

From: Nina Patel <nina.patel@medicorelabs.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tom Reeves <tom.reeves@medicorelabs.com>, procurement@medicorelabs.com
Date: Thu, 01 Jul 2027 16:40:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Scheduling Redwood demo — vendor onboarding items

Thanks everyone — questionnaire now complete and NDA uploaded to the vendor portal (procurement confirmed). Wed 30 Jun 9am PT works for Tom after all (flight schedule changed). We’ll join the call and focus the Q&A on the two procurement items and the KMS/HSM note Karthik flagged. Appreciate the quick turnaround.

See you Wed — Nina
